items.answer: False ceilings provide thermal insulation by creating an air gap between the soffit and the false ceiling. They reduce the air volume of a room and, as a result, the air-conditioning load. Thus, the air-conditioning requirement is reduced, resulting in lower electricity bills. Ceilings reflect and diffuse light. A ceiling that reflects and diffuses light well reduces the need for artificial lighting. This results in improved energy efficiency and a better working environment.
